raw_review_excerpt:
The S1 slice plan is well-grounded against the PRD execution map row, the V1 workflow YAML, the bundled-defaults generator/test surface, and the CLI validate command. All load-bearing claims about sentinel tokens (PLAN_READY, PLAN_APPROVED, COMPLETE, VALIDATED), the `.claude/archon/plans/*.plan.md` writer/reader contract, and the proof commands (validate workflows, check:bundled, bundled-defaults.test.ts) are verified against the current repo. The plan correctly self-gates on Q1 (PRD backlink handoff) with a concrete resolution path via frontmatter_link_sync.py. One minor state-hygiene note: the Doc Sync Log records a frontmatter_link_sync dry-run as already performed, but P0-T3 remains in proposed status in the state.json sidecar, suggesting premature log entry or missing state sync. No freeze blockers found.

Issues:

issues.title: Doc Sync Log entry #3 predates P0-T3 execution
issues.details: The Doc Sync Log (line 322) records that frontmatter_link_sync.py --check was run and its output captured ('still wants to rewrite both this slice plan and the PRD'). However, P0-T3 in the state.json sidecar remains in proposed status, and P0-T3's exit criteria require recording this result. Either the log entry was written before the task was formally started/completed, or the state.json was not synced after the dry-run. This is a state-hygiene gap, not a correctness or feasibility issue.
issues.suggested_fix: When P0-T3 is formally executed, update the state.json sidecar to reflect in_progress or done status, or defer the Doc Sync Log entry until P0-T3 is actually executed within the workflow. No plan text change is required — this resolves naturally during normal P0 execution.
